description: This file defines data structures and utility functions related to tracking and displaying cost usage metrics, such as total input/output tokens, cache reads/writes, total costs, and summaries for daily and overall usage within a system.

classes.name: GatewayCostUsageTotals
classes.description: Stores total cost usage metrics such as input, output, cache read/write counts, total tokens, total cost, and missing entries.

classes.name: GatewayCostUsageDay
classes.description: Represents cost usage data for a specific date, encapsulating totals and providing computed properties for individual metrics.

classes.name: GatewayCostUsageSummary
classes.description: Summarizes cost usage over multiple days, including an array of daily data and overall totals.

methods.name: formatUsd
methods.description: Formats a Double value into a USD string with appropriate decimal places for display.

methods.name: formatTokenCount
methods.description: Formats an integer token count into a more readable string, using 'k' or 'm' suffixes as appropriate.

methods.name: loadSummary
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the cost usage summary data via a network request.
